verdict.rationale: Thoropass, a compliance SaaS platform, documents an official MCP server in a dedicated help article ('Connecting to the Thoropass MCP server'). It lets an AI assistant work inside the workspace within user-set limits, list audits and evidence requests, and add comments, attachments, and status updates, and the probe confirms the article exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the server working, and documentation in the pack of auth/setup steps and supported MCP clients.
